title: Campus Library Late-Night Study Hours Notice
context: Posted at the main entrance of Green Memorial Library
contentText:
NOTICE: Extended Final Exam Study Hours
From Monday, May 5 through Thursday, May 15, the Central Reading Room and 2nd Floor Silent Study Commons will remain open 24 hours daily. Student ID card access is required after 10:00 PM at the West entrance only. Campus Escort Services will operate continuous shuttles between the library and all residence halls every 20 minutes from 11:00 PM to 5:00 AM. Free coffee and quiet study snacks will be served nightly in Room 104 starting at midnight.

questions.q: What requirement must students meet to enter the library after 10:00 PM?
options: Present a valid student identification card at the West entrance
Reserve a designated study carrel 24 hours in advance
Register with the campus night security desk by phone
Pay a late-night facility fee at the circulation desk
questions.why: The notice clearly specifies that 'Student ID card access is required after 10:00 PM at the West entrance only.'

questions.q: What service is provided to assist students returning to dormitories late at night?
options: Designated parking permits for private vehicles
Subsidized city bus passes available at Room 104
Continuous campus shuttle vans running every 20 minutes
Accompanied bicycle rentals from the information desk
questions.why: The text states that Campus Escort Services operate continuous shuttles between the library and residence halls every 20 minutes.

questions.q: The word 'commons' in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to:
options: ordinary items
shared public area
private faculty offices
underground storage vaults
questions.why: In this context, 'Silent Study Commons' refers to a shared, communal study space for students.

title: Apartment Maintenance and HVAC Inspection Notice
context: Email from Oakridge Student Living Management to all building residents
contentText:
Subject: Mandatory Semi-Annual HVAC Filter Replacement & Smoke Detector Audit
Dear Residents,
Our certified facilities maintenance technicians will enter all apartment suites on Wednesday, October 18, between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM to replace air intake filters and test emergency smoke alarms. You do not need to be present during the inspection; however, please ensure all household pets are secured in a bedroom or travel crate. Technicians will leave a completion card on your kitchen counter once the check is finalized. If your deadbolt lock has been privately modified, please contact the leasing office immediately.

questions.q: What are residents instructed to do regarding their pets during the maintenance visit?
options: Remove them from the apartment premises entirely for the entire day
Secure them inside a bedroom or an enclosed travel crate
Leave them in the main living room with food and water
Register them with the building manager before 9:00 AM
questions.why: The email explicitly requests: 'please ensure all household pets are secured in a bedroom or travel crate.'

questions.q: How will residents know that technicians have finished working in their apartment?
options: They will receive an automated text confirmation on their phone
A replacement key will be left in their mailbox
The building manager will phone them directly
A completion card will be placed on the kitchen counter
questions.why: The email notes that 'Technicians will leave a completion card on your kitchen counter once the check is finalized.'

title: Biology Lab Group Project Coordination Text Chain
context: Text message chain among three biology lab partners
contentText:
Marcus (1:15 PM): Hey guys, Dr. Alvarez just posted the rubric for our water ecology report. We need 4 peer-reviewed citations minimum.
Elena (1:17 PM): I already pulled two journal articles on microplastic filtration in local watersheds from JSTOR.
Sam (1:19 PM): Perfect. I can synthesize the lab sample data into comparison charts tonight. Can we meet at the campus cafe tomorrow at 3 PM to merge our drafts?
Marcus (1:22 PM): I have organic chemistry lab until 3:30 PM. Could we do 4:00 PM at the science library seminar room instead?
Elena (1:23 PM): 4:00 PM works for me! I will reserve Room 3B right now.
Sam (1:24 PM): Sounds good, see you both at 4.

questions.q: Why is Marcus unable to meet at the campus cafe at 3:00 PM?
options: He must complete another laboratory class until 3:30 PM
He has to work a shift at the campus library
He has an advising appointment with Dr. Alvarez
He needs to finish analyzing the microplastic data
questions.why: Marcus explicitly states: 'I have organic chemistry lab until 3:30 PM.'

questions.q: What task has Elena volunteered to do immediately?
options: Gather four additional peer-reviewed citations
Draft the executive summary of the lab report
Book seminar Room 3B in the science library
Create the comparative data charts
questions.why: Elena responds: '4:00 PM works for me! I will reserve Room 3B right now.'

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of this text message exchange?
options: To request an extension on a laboratory assignment deadline
To debate scientific findings regarding local watershed contamination
To distribute research duties and schedule a joint meeting time
To complain about the professor's strict grading expectations
questions.why: The students are sharing what tasks they have done and settling on a time and venue to compile their report.

title: Campus Dining Hall Daily Specials & Allergen Advisory
context: Dining Services digital display board at North Quad Cafeteria
contentText:
TODAY'S SPECIALS — NORTH QUAD DINING COMMONS
• Station 1 (Global Hearth): Roasted Moroccan Chickpea Tagine with saffron couscous [Vegan, Nut-Free, Halal]
• Station 2 (Chef's Grill): Grass-Fed Herb Burgers served with sweet potato wedges. Gluten-free buns available upon request [Contains dairy; egg-free]
• Station 3 (Pacific Wok): Ginger Sesame Tofu Stir-Fry over brown rice [Contains soy & sesame; Vegetarian]

title: Campus Recreation Center Pool Closure and Maintenance Notice
context: Physical bulletin board flyer in the Aquatics Center lobby
contentText:
ATTENTION AQUATICS PATRONS: Temporary Lap Pool Closure
The 50-meter competition pool will close for scheduled tile resurfacing and chemical filtration overhaul from August 1 to August 12. During this closure period, all morning master swim practices and open recreational lap swimming will be relocated to the adjacent indoor therapy pool. Please observe modified lane allocations: Lanes 1–3 are designated for slow/medium swimmers, and Lanes 4–6 are reserved for fast lap training. Locker rooms will remain fully accessible throughout the project.

title: Email Regarding Campus Parking Permit Renewals
context: Official message sent from Transportation & Parking Services to commuter students
contentText:
Subject: Spring Semester Commuter Parking Permits Now Available Online
Dear Student,
Online renewal for Spring Commuter (Zone C) parking permits opens Monday, December 1st at 8:00 AM via your MyCampus portal. Due to upcoming construction on the South Garage, Zone C permit quotas have been reduced by 15% this term. Permits will be awarded on a strict first-come, first-served basis. If your vehicle license plate or residential address has changed since fall term, you must update your vehicle profile prior to submitting your permit request. Physical hangtags are no longer issued; your license plate serves as your digital permit.

questions.q: Why has the number of available Zone C parking permits been decreased?
options: The university is increasing regional public transit subsidies
Permit prices have increased significantly for the spring term
Construction work is scheduled to take place on the South Garage
Commuter student enrollment has fallen over the past semester
questions.why: The email notes: 'Due to upcoming construction on the South Garage, Zone C permit quotas have been reduced by 15% this term.'

questions.q: How does the parking enforcement office verify authorized commuter vehicles?
options: By scanning plastic hangtags hung from the rearview mirror
By scanning the vehicle's registered license plate electronically
By checking paper receipt permits displayed on the windshield
By requiring students to check in with a gate attendant
questions.why: The text explains: 'Physical hangtags are no longer issued; your license plate serves as your digital permit.'

questions.q: The word 'quotas' in the passage is closest in meaning to:
options: enforcement fines
predetermined limits
maintenance expenses
geographic boundaries
questions.why: In this context, 'permit quotas' refers to the set limits or allowances of permits made available.

title: University IT Service Desk Maintenance and Outage Alert
context: Broadcast email and portal notification from University Information Technology
contentText:
SYSTEM ADVISORY: Enterprise Cloud Storage and Learning Management System Maintenance
Please be advised that University IT will perform critical database upgrades this Saturday, March 12, from 1:00 AM to 6:00 AM EST. During this five-hour maintenance window, the Canvas course management platform, campus cloud file drives, and student portal registration modules will be inaccessible. However, campus Wi-Fi networks and official university email (@university.edu) will continue to operate without interruption. Faculty have been instructed not to schedule any assignment deadlines or online quizzes during this downtime.

questions.q: According to the advisory, which service will remain fully functional during the maintenance window?
options: The Canvas course management system
The student portal registration portal
Official student and faculty email accounts
Campus cloud file storage drives
questions.why: The notice explicitly confirms: 'campus Wi-Fi networks and official university email (@university.edu) will continue to operate without interruption.'

questions.q: What step has the university taken to prevent academic disruption during the maintenance?
options: Extended all semester deadlines automatically by one week
Directed faculty not to schedule quizzes or deadlines during the downtime
Arranged temporary alternative servers for file storage
Provided off-campus internet stipends for affected students
questions.why: The text states: 'Faculty have been instructed not to schedule any assignment deadlines or online quizzes during this downtime.'
